rewrite.before:
What you worked out by the end of trial 1:
  [1] Purple is the best patch: unripe 0.25, ripe 0.5, over-ripe 0.4 per apple, and it regrows well while neighbours hang; cyan pays far less (0.25/0.5/1.0) and its patch died once stripped.
  [2] Ripe pays double unripe, so let apples ripen rather than eating them unripe, unless the patch is about to be stripped by others.
  [3] Stripping a patch bare kills it: with no apples hanging near an empty cell it never regrows. Leave a few apples hanging as 'seed' neighbours so emptied cells keep coming back.
  [4] Over-ripe still pays (purple 0.4, cyan 1.0) and rots soon, so grab over-ripe apples before they vanish; a rotted apple pays nobody.
  [5] D is the main rival: it camps the same purple patch and zapped me back 3 times. A also camps and zapped me once. Do not linger in a patch an agent is working; move to a patch they are not in.
  [6] Zaps cost me the walk back plus 12 frozen steps, which is far more than any apple is worth; avoid standing in an agent's faced line and do not try to fight over a patch.
  [7] C ate nothing in my view and E ate little: they are less of a threat than A and D.
  [8] Regrowth is steep: cells with several neighbours return within the trial, with one or two neighbours almost never. Harvest the edges of a patch last, keeping the middle apples as neighbours.
  [9] Rotting apples regrow by themselves shortly after, whatever is around, so a rotted cell is a reliable future apple.
  [10] Watch which cells I empty and how fast they return; that hidden colour/stage regrowth rate decides where to keep working.

What you meant to try this trial:
  [11] Trial 2: every patch I have seen is stripped bare (purple 4-8/9-13, purple 8-12/4-8, yellow, green all 0 apples). My emptied purple cells stay empty 25-42 steps with 0 neighbours, so stripped patches (revised t77)
  [12] If A or D is already camping a patch, leave and find another purple patch or a fresh one rather than contesting it.
  [13] Test whether eating an apple at over-ripe makes its cell regrow faster or slower than eating it ripe, by watching cells I empty.
  [14] Keep clear of any agent's faced direction; if zapped, relocate to a different patch instead of returning to the same spot.
